title: View directory tree excluding specific folders
summary: Display the directory structure while ignoring specific directories (like node_modules or .git) to reduce clutter.

steps.explain: Run `tree` with `-I` followed by the name of the directory you want to ignore.

placeholders.name: DIR_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the directory to exclude from the output.

steps.expect: A tree structure that does not show the specified directory or its contents.
